decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's core inkjet and ink expertise, so in-house R&D can keep refining it from customer feedback, which makes it a durable part of the portfolio.
Coding on non-absorbent surfaces draws on the firm's deep ink chemistry know-how and serves demanding industrial applications, so the firm can assimilate early results and keep improving the product.

The CodeScan app succeeds PharmaScan and supports the firm's traceability and verification strategy, so it rests on accumulated knowledge, though app products may be renamed or folded into other offerings.

Inline code verification is central to the firm's serialization and end-to-end traceability direction and builds on its established verification know-how, so the firm can interpret its results well and improve it.

Layout design software supports common operation across all of the firm's printing systems and fits its digitalization path, so it is valuable as a complement even if it later merges into a broader software suite.
